confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors are bounded estimates from Japan-wide and Tokyo yen price points (government-based eating-out beer about ¥667 and coffee about ¥622 for Tokyo Special Wards in January 2026, plus crowd-sourced cappuccino and cocktail figures), adjusted down for Hiroshima. Hiroshima-specific meal guides are dated (2023-2024). Cocktail and wine anchors are weak and were set using the local price relationship to beer (cocktail about 1.8x beer, wine glass about 1.5x beer). Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no booking pages or current listings were inspected. FX caveat: the 2026-03-20 observation is the latest RBA figure I could verify from the RBA exchange-rates page in search results. The live F11 table and later observations were not retrieved, so the rate is about seven months older than the generation date. The yen-to-USD conversion for the anchors assumes roughly ¥150 per USD, which was not verified by search.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. Basis is Japan national and Tokyo/Osaka yen price points, scaled down for Hiroshima as a mid-sized city, then converted to USD at an assumed ¥150 per USD. Accommodation is judged against typical Japanese city-centre rates for July.
